append_metrics.name: Datacenter infrastructure market share (cooling + power combined)
append_metrics.description: Schneider Electric estimated 20–25% of global datacenter infrastructure market (thermal + power systems), per analyst consensus 2025. Cooling-specific share ~18–22%.

append_metrics.name: Annual revenue (FY2025 estimate)
append_metrics.description: Schneider Electric FY2025 total revenue ~$37–38 billion USD; Infrastructure Solutions division (data centers, thermal) ~$12–14 billion.

node_patches.append_notes: Schneider Electric competes directly with Vertiv across cooling and power infrastructure. Strong in facility-level integration and legacy datacenters; gaining share in AI-focused liquid-cooling buildouts.
